Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to organize how your team sees work. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now capture any combination of filters, grouping, and sorting as a named view you can return to instantly.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every subscriber gets access without an upgrade. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from sprint boards and personal task lists to client-specific dashboards. Once you've built a view you like, it can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own.

We built this feature based on requests from teams managing multiple projects across different workflows, and we think it will make daily planning noticeably easier. Give it a try on your next project and let us know what you think.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
